Lucas Reyes
lucas.reyes@example.com | Raleigh, NC
Lucas Reyes has 6 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Harborlight Systems (2022-2026), where
they introduced Terraform-managed infrastructure, cutting provisioning time by
84%. Before that, Backend Engineer at Redbank Infrastructure (2021-2022).
Before that, Software Engineer I at Grayline Computing (2020-2021). Education:
B.S. Information Systems, University of Minnesota, 2020. Core skills:
PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Distributed systems, Redis, TypeScript, REST API
design, AWS, gRPC, Terraform, Node.js, Kubernetes.
